name: SMPIT BISA Depok
address: Jl. Cagar Alam Selatan No.17, Pancoran Mas, Kota Depok

notes.id: Uang pangkal 3 pilihan: I Rp9.500.000, II Rp8.500.000, III Rp7.500.000 (termasuk seragam, modul, kegiatan). Kuota 20 putra dan 10 putri.
notes.en: Three entry-fee options: I Rp9,500,000, II Rp8,500,000, III Rp7,500,000 (incl. uniforms, modules, activities). Quota 20 boys and 10 girls.

source.title: SPMB SMPIT BISA Depok TA 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

period.id: Gelombang 2: 1 Des 2026–31 Jan 2027; gelombang 3: 1 Feb–30 Apr 2027
period.en: Wave 2: 1 Dec 2026–31 Jan 2027; wave 3: 1 Feb–30 Apr 2027

steps.id: Bayar uang pendaftaran Rp500.000 (transfer BSI a.n. SDIT BISA Depok)
steps.en: Pay the Rp500,000 registration fee (BSI transfer to SDIT BISA Depok)
Fill in the online registration form

steps.id: Buat janji jadwal tes dan observasi dengan sekolah
steps.en: Book a test and observation slot with the school

steps.id: Ikuti tes dan observasi dengan membawa Formulir Data dan Informasi Tambahan (FDIT)
steps.en: Attend the test and observation, bringing the completed additional data form (FDIT)

steps.id: Jika lulus: lunasi uang masuk, lengkapi berkas, tanda tangani Surat Patuh Aturan Pendidikan
steps.en: If accepted: pay the entry fee in full, submit documents, sign the school rules agreement

documents.en: Copy of grade 4, 5 and 6 report cards

documents.id: Surat keterangan baik dari sekolah asal
Fotokopi akta kelahiran, KK, KTP ayah dan ibu (masing-masing 3 lembar)
documents.en: Copies of birth certificate, family card, both parents' ID cards (3 each)

documents.id: Pas foto 3×4 dan 4×6 latar biru (masing-masing 4 lembar)

documents.en: Health certificate from a community health centre

source.title: SPMB SMPIT BISA Depok TA 2027/2028 (situs resmi)
